label: Otlu peynir
note: Raw milk; wild herbs mixed into the curd; brined and matured underground

about.text: A semi-hard, salty cheese of the Van province in Turkey, flavoured with wild herbs and matured underground.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Studies (Tuncturk and Coskun 2002; Tarakci et al. 2004) compare brine ripening with dry salting and filling; no starter cultures are named.

steps.name: mix
steps.note: Alliums, thyme, Silene vulgaris, Chaerophyllum and others are mixed into the curd; the herbs are antimicrobial and lengthen shelf life.

steps.name: press
steps.note: The curd with herbs is drained and pressed.
